# LakazAgri
> Free offline-first Android app for farm-to-buyer coordination and match-level trust across Sub-Saharan Africa. Developed in Mauritius.

## Positioning
LakazAgri targets agri-food systems across Sub-Saharan Africa — smallholder farmers, cooperatives, hotels, markets, traders and institutions. Mauritius is the development and pilot base, not the sole market.

## Site
- Homepage: https://lakazagri.mkweli.tech/
- Contact: support@mkweli.tech
- Phone: +230 5479 6356

## Product (pilot v1.3-trust)
Farmers post crop availability and buyers post demand; both sides browse matches. On a match they open a **trust / order record**: origin and batch ID, quality photos (offline), payment status and receipt proof. Offline-first for rural connectivity.
